eval: (() => { const ks = []; for (let i = localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.startsWith('dao-')) ks.push(k); } ks.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)); location.reload(); return 'cleared'; })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; p.resetRealm(); document.getElementById('btn-player-fill').click(); const preview = p.expPreview(); const manual = p.state.enemyQueue.reduce((s, u) => s + Math.max(1, Math.ceil(u.maxHp / 10)), 0); window.__t = { preview, manual, before: p.realm().totalExp }; p.start(); const c = p.state.playerQueue.find(u => u.cardType === 'char'); c.maxHp = 99999; c.hp = 99999; return JSON.stringify({ preview, manual, formulaOk: preview === manual, running: p.state.running }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; const r = p.realm(); return JSON.stringify({ winner: '胜' , gained: r.totalExp - window.__t.before, expected: window.__t.preview, killAccountOk: r.totalExp - window.__t.before === window.__t.preview, realm: r.title, exp: r.exp, need: r.need, lootLine: [...document.querySelectorAll('#loot-log .loot-line')].map(l => l.textContent).find(t => t.includes('修为')) }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; p.setStage(7); p.resetRealm(); document.getElementById('btn-player-fill').click(); const preview = p.expPreview(); const manual = p.state.enemyQueue.reduce((s, u) => s + Math.max(1, Math.ceil(u.maxHp / 10)), 0); window.__t = { preview, manual3x: manual * 3, before: p.realm().totalExp }; p.start(); for (const u of p.state.playerQueue) { u.atk = 9999; } const c = p.state.playerQueue.find(u => u.cardType === 'char'); c.maxHp = 99999; c.hp = 99999; return JSON.stringify({ bossPreview: preview, manual3x: manual * 3, boss3xOk: preview === manual * 3, running: p.state.running }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; const r = p.realm(); return JSON.stringify({ gained: r.totalExp - window.__t.before, expected: window.__t.preview, bossAccountOk: r.totalExp - window.__t.before === window.__t.preview, realm: r.title }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; p.setStage(0); p.resetRealm(); document.getElementById('btn-reset').click(); const char = p.state.playerQueue.find(u => u.cardType === 'char'); const before = { maxHp: char.maxHp, atk: char.atk, title: p.realm().title }; const r = p.addExp(30); const after = p.state.playerQueue.find(u => u.cardType === 'char'); const hpRatio = after.maxHp / before.maxHp; return JSON.stringify({ before, after: { maxHp: after.maxHp, atk: after.atk, title: r.title }, levels: r.levels, hpRatio: +hpRatio.toFixed(4), gain2pctOk: hpRatio > 1.015 && hpRatio < 1.025, uiTitle: document.getElementById('realm-title').textContent, uiNum: document.getElementById('realm-exp-num').textContent, barWidth: document.getElementById('realm-bar').style.width }); })()

(() => { const box = document.getElementById('realm-box'); const r = box.getBoundingClientRect(); box.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.x + r.width / 2, clientY: r.y + r.height / 2 })); const tip = document.getElementById('card-tip'); return JSON.stringify({ tipShown: !tip.hidden, text: tip.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 140) }); })()
